title: Project
description: The site's own record of a project: the card and the page header. File: src/content/projects/<slug>.mdx. The body is an optional long write-up; the project's read-me comes from its brief (project-brief.schema.json), which the project repo owns.

slug.description: Route: /projects/<slug>. Also the key that a brief must match.

featured.description: Expanded by default on the home page.

description.description: One or two sentences for the card and the page description.

link.description: Source or write-up URL. "#" means none yet.

embed.description: Rendered in an iframe under "Try It".

tag.description: Short label on the card, e.g. the year.

published.description: false holds the project: file stays, no card, no route.

image.description: Site-relative path under public/ or an absolute URL.
